plugins.name: no-co-authored
plugins.description: Strips Co-Authored-By trailers and the Claude Code footer from git commit messages before they run.

plugins.name: git-sign-key
plugins.description: Signs git commits with a ~/.claude/sign.key file via SSH signing instead of the ssh-agent.

plugins.name: cctools-edit
plugins.description: Installs the cc-tools binary for the host OS and routes Read/Write/Edit/MultiEdit through it so file encodings (Latin-1/Windows-1252/UTF-8) are preserved instead of corrupted.
